status.en: 15 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 88% more than the week before, most of them in Kivu, Kinshasa and Kigali.
status.nb: 15 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 88 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Kivu, Kinshasa og Kigali.

summary.en: M23 rebels continue advancing in eastern DRC, seizing towns and planning a 3,300‑house project to ease the Goma housing crisis, while ADF gunmen keep killing civilians in Ituri province. FARDC commanders and UPDF forces assessed joint operations against ADF in Cantine, and MONUSCO escorted 380 civilians after clashes in Ituri. Kabila rebels shot down a DRC fighter jet, and Rwanda is preparing to serve as a European deportation hub for asylum seekers, prompting diplomatic protest from the DRC. Kenya and the DRC are discussing a détente at a quadripartite summit in Oyo, Republic of Congo. 1,158 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: M23‑opprørerne fortsetter fremrykkingen i østlige DRC, erobrer byer og planlegger et boligprosjekt på 3 300 hus for å lindre boligmangelen i Goma, mens ADF-våpnere fortsetter å drepe sivile i Ituri-provinsen. FARDC-kommandanter og UPDF-styrker vurderte felles operasjoner mot ADF i Cantine, og MONUSCO eskorterte 380 sivile etter sammenstøt i Ituri. Kabila-opprørerne skjøt ned et DRC-jagerfly, og Rwanda forbereder seg på å fungere som et europeisk deportasjonssenter for asylsøkere, noe som førte til diplomatisk protest fra DRC. Kenya og DRC diskuterer en avspenning på et kvartettmøte i Oyo, Republikken Kongo. 1 158 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
